subject: Slot scouting + quick pre-demo use-case & volume check
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunlop <alex.dunlop@parcelpad.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Slot scouting + quick pre-demo use-case & volume check

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the interest in Redwood. I grabbed your signup metadata and wanted to do a short pre-demo check so we tailor the session. Two quick asks before we lock a time (should take < 10 minutes):

1) Use case (one line): what's the main feature you're looking to evaluate? (examples: real-time chat assistant, ai-assisted search, embeddings for semantic search)
2) Typical volume: daily users or transactions and expected peak QPS / concurrent requests during peak window
3) Timeline: target pilot start date and any procurement gating (PO/Legal)

We have an intake form attached if you prefer to fill it out: pre-demo-intake-form.pdf

If you'd rather pick a time, here's a 30-min slot list: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo — otherwise send 3 windows that work for you and we'll propose something.

Quick note on self-serve signups vs SDR outreach: if this came through self-serve, we can still run a short walkthrough focused on the console and how to get a sandbox running in minutes. If you're already evaluating production constraints (SLA, latency, data residency), let us know and we'll include a short ops overview.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0194

Attachments: pre-demo-intake-form.pdf (1 page - short questionnaire)

From: Alex Dunlop <alex.dunlop@parcelpad.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Slot scouting + quick pre-demo use-case & volume check

Thanks Soojin — happy to provide a quick snapshot. Answers inline: 

Use case: Customer support triage + suggested replies for CS agents (mix of retrieval + generation).
Volume: ~120k tickets/month across their platform; expected peak ~140 reqs/sec during US business hours, typical concurrency for the pilot ~8–12 workers.
Timeline: aiming for a pilot kick-off in early January (PO expected in Dec), but we want a technical check in the next 2 weeks.

Attached is our internal product deck (high-level) that shows current flow and where we'd like Redwood to sit.

Looking at my calendar, I can do:
- Tue Nov 24 11:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Nov 25 09:00–09:30 PT
- Thu Nov 26 14:00–14:30 PT

If none of those work, I can accept a calendar invite.

—Alex
Alex Dunlop
Head of Platform, ParcelPad
alex.dunlop@parcelpad.com | +1 212-555-0123

Attachments: parcelpad-product-deck.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunlop <alex.dunlop@parcelpad.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Slot scouting + quick pre-demo use-case & volume check

Perfect, thanks Alex — that helps a lot. Given the ticketing triage use case and your peak numbers, we'll include:

- A live walkthrough of our hosted API (streaming vs non-streaming) and KV/cache strategies for low-latency suggestions
- A short sketch of batching and quantization settings that map to 140 QPS peaks
- Notes on pilot infra footprint and cost estimate for the traffic profile you provided

I booked Tue Nov 24 11:00 PT on our side tentatively. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite with the plan and attach a short tech checklist so your engineers can join prepared. If you'd prefer Wed Nov 25 at 09:00, say the word and we'll flip it.

Quick clarifying Qs (one-line answers are fine):
- Are your inference requests coming from server-side workers or client devices?
- Do you need single-tenant isolation for pilot data (Private/Dedicated) or is hosted acceptable for now?

Calendly in case you want to pick another slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo

Thanks —
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
